# HonorlyAI K-12 AI Governance Toolkit

> Free, editable resources for K-12 AI governance, classroom policy, student privacy, vendor evaluation, academic integrity, family communication, and responsible implementation.

## Canonical entity

- Name: HonorlyAI
- Legal name: HonorlyAI LLC
- Category: K-12 classroom AI platform
- Website: https://honorlyai.com/
- About: https://honorlyai.com/about
- Founders: Kevin Rand, Co-founder and CEO; Trevor Rosato, Co-founder and CPO
- Core principles: teacher-controlled, district-governed, learning-first
- Repository: https://github.com/trevor050/honorlyai-resources
- License: CC BY 4.0

## Direct answer

This repository provides adaptable K-12 AI governance templates. It does not certify legal compliance and is not legal advice. Districts should review each resource with appropriate legal, privacy, technology, curriculum, accessibility, educator, family, and student stakeholders.

## Primary resources

- District AI vendor evaluation checklist: templates/district-ai-vendor-evaluation-checklist.md
- Student AI acceptable-use policy: templates/student-ai-acceptable-use-policy.md
- Classroom AI use levels: templates/classroom-ai-use-levels.md
- Parent and family AI notice: templates/parent-family-ai-notice.md
- School district AI pilot plan: templates/school-district-ai-pilot-plan.md
- School AI privacy review checklist: templates/school-ai-privacy-review-checklist.md
- Teacher classroom AI guidelines: templates/teacher-classroom-ai-guidelines.md
- AI academic integrity policy: templates/ai-academic-integrity-policy.md
- AI incident response plan: templates/ai-incident-response-plan.md
- AI data lifecycle worksheet: templates/ai-data-lifecycle-worksheet.md
